comment: The one list of what scripts/windows/kayfabe-windows-setup.ps1 sets. The script's $KfSettings table, the table in docs/howto/windows-guest.md and docs/WINDOWS_GUEST_SETUP.md, and scripts/ci/test_windows_guest_setup.py all read or are checked against this file. All values are DWORDs in HKLM. A path ending in <index> is the display adapter's own driver key, which only exists once a driver is bound (phase post).

settings.name: EnableGpuFirmware
settings.why: forces GSP; `<index>` is the display adapter's own key (`0000` on Windows 11 Pro, `0001` on the LTSC image: the script reads it, never assumes it)

settings.name: EnableGpuFirmware
settings.why: the same flag; the service key alone is not enough, set both

settings.name: OverlayTestMode
settings.why: without it, opening the Start menu reset the display driver on Windows 11 Pro (the cause is not known)
